about: Atlas Bikes questions with their expected behavior. 'expected_from' is the first checkpoint meant to pass the case. Checks inspect the evidence that reached the model, routing, and tool results, not prose quality. 'kind' and 'relevant' (the blocks that answer the question) are used by `measure` from part-07; 'variants' are rewordings used to test stability.

cases.question: What battery warranty applies to a C-3 bought on 15 March 2026?
variants: My C-3 was bought on 15 March 2026. How many years of battery warranty do I have?

cases.question: How do I get back into the display after forgetting the PIN?
cases.behavior: The dealer recovery procedure reaches the model despite different wording.
variants: I forgot my display PIN, how can I unlock it?

cases.question: What does error E-417 mean, and what should I check?
cases.behavior: The E-417 entry reaches the model. Vector search alone can't see exact codes.
variants: E-417 on the display, what does that mean?

cases.question: Is a rear mudguard required on the cargo version of the C-3?
cases.behavior: The exception from the scanned guide reaches the model with correct text.

checks.text: the rear mudguard is not required

cases.question: What does it mean when the C-3 display blinks twice?
cases.behavior: The answer, which is only in the slide's speaker notes, reaches the model.
variants: The C-3 screen flashes two times. What is wrong?

cases.question: How much capacity did pack A keep after 500 charge cycles?
cases.behavior: The value printed only in Figure 2 reaches the model.

cases.question: Do I need to fit a rear mudguard on a C-3?
cases.behavior: The rule arrives together with its cargo-version exception.

cases.question: Which battery check applies when the battery casing of a C-3 has been opened?
cases.behavior: R07 reaches the model with the configuration it applies to.

cases.question: How much capacity did pack A keep after 500 charge cycles?
cases.behavior: The model receives the figure itself (image reference and page), not only a description of it.

cases.question: What does error E-417 mean, and what should I check?
cases.behavior: The exact code's entry ranks first, above look-alike codes.

cases.question: What battery warranty applies to a C-3 bought on 15 March 2026?
cases.behavior: Only the policy that applies to this product and purchase date reaches the model.

cases.question: What battery warranty applies to a C-3 bought on 15 March 2025?
cases.behavior: Answer 2 years from WARR-R1; the newer policy doesn't apply to 2025 purchases.

cases.question: How long is the battery warranty?
cases.behavior: Ask for the product and purchase date instead of picking a policy.

cases.question: List all battery safety checks for the C-3 under revision 5.
cases.behavior: All eleven checks R01-R11, with a guarantee that the list is complete rather than a lucky retrieval.

cases.question: What share of bikes passed final inspection without rework across batches A and B?
cases.behavior: 89 of 110 bikes, about 80.9%, computed rather than averaged.

cases.question: Which chargers are affected by the recall?
cases.behavior: The recall bulletin reaches the model, although the word 'recall' appears only in its title. Was held-out H12 until part-07 used it to fix the searched forms.
